To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the dynamics of cold atoms in a hollow waveguide is chaotic when the beam intensity is periodically modulated and the quantum dynamics of atoms is also influenced by the modulation.

we have studied the nonlinear dynamics of cold atoms in hollow optical fiber and we found that the atoms will be accumulated in annular regions for chaotic dynamics and the quantum collapses and revivals will be suppressed for periodically modulated optical potentials.

(1) the two-dimensional nonlinear dynamics for the evanescent-wave cold atoms guided in the hollow fiber are investigated; (2) the chaotic dynamics and global chaos are found for the classical dynamics of the evanescent wave guided atoms; (3) the quantum collapses and revivals are found for the quantum dynamics of the evanscent wave guided atoms in the hollow fiber; (4) the variance of atomic positions and the atomic angular momentum are found to influence the evolution of the wave function
